optimizedDescription.value: Manage tracked implementation files and confirmed spec-file-symbol links throughout active change reviews.

optimizedContext.value:
# Change Implementation

## Rules

- Expose under `specd changes implementation`.
- `list <name>`: return tracked files (`open`, `resolved`, `ignored`, `removed`), confirmed links by `specId` and file, symbol refinements, and SDK projection (`sdk:build-implementation-review`). Rely on SDK projection; do not implement fallback policy or rewrite stored links.
- `add <name> --spec <specId> --file <path> [--symbol <name> ...]`: use raw project-relative path; require file exists else throw `ImplementationFileNotFoundError`; create/confirm link; add symbols; set tracked file state `open`; preserve explicit file-level links vs symbol containers.
- `resolve <name> --file <paths...>`: comma-separated paths; require all files exist and are tracked; reject `removed`; update review state to `resolved` only without modifying links.
- `unresolve <name> --file <paths...>`: comma-separated paths; require all files exist and are tracked (`resolved` or `ignored`); reject `removed`; set state `open` only.
- `ignore <name> --file <paths...>`: comma-separated paths; existing tracked files (including `removed`) can be missing; new untracked files require physical existence else throw `ImplementationFileNotFoundError`; set state `ignored`, preserve links.
- `remove <name> --spec <specId> --file <path> [--symbol <name> ...]`: with symbols, remove named refinements; without symbols, remove entire spec-file set. Removing last symbol removes implicit container but preserves explicit file-level link.
- `review <name>`: inspect tracked files/links via SDK projection; render `resolved`, `ambiguous`, `unresolved`, `missing` outcomes; distinguish incomplete graph from total absence, symbol diagnostics from archive/workspace failures, sidecar updates outside spec scope; never mutate state/links.
- Manual management and autodetection use raw project-relative paths during active change; canonical `workspace:path` normalization occurs at archive.

## Constraints

- State subcommands validate atomically.
- Link mutations and tracked-file review-state mutations remain distinct.
